capabilities: Draws Git-style branch lines connecting headings
Color-codes each of the six heading levels
Traces a node's path from the filename on hover or focus
Folds or expands sections on node click
Renders in the editor and Reading view
disambiguation: Not a Git integration; it only draws Git-style branch lines to visualize heading ancestry.
problem: Obsidian shows heading structure only as a flat outline, with no in-editor visual trace of a heading's ancestry.
summary: Heading tree visualizer that draws Git-style branch lines through headings, color-coded by level, with click-to-fold sections.
